answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 31242 Country: United Kingdom Title: Please explain how to read sunnah ghair moakkada asr and isha 3rd and 4th raka specially. Question: Please explain how to read sunnah ghair moakkada asr and isha 3rd and 4th raka specially. Answer ID: 31242 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 514/392/L=1432) Four rakah shall be offered with one salam. And it is necessary to include any other surah along with Surah al-Fatiha in each rakah. Also, you will have to do qa’dah on two rakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
